description: Meeting Employer Needs through a Three-Tiered Approach to Curriculum Design is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by The Ohio State University Department of Food, Agricultural, and Biological Engineering. The Ohio State University is collaborating with employers, non-profits, Historically Black Colleges and Universities, and community and technical colleges to redesign curricula for career pathways in the skilled trades, middle management, and technical professions related to water resources management. Coverage: Coastal Ohio (2025). The toolkit gives Coastal Ohio as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
